title: MoSe2 SOC GW-BSE optical response (QE/BerkeleyGW)
summary: Reproduce the SOC-enabled Quantum ESPRESSO to BerkeleyGW GW-BSE optical response of monolayer MoSe2 from staged structure and pseudopotentials.
taskPrompt: Read input/problem_spec.md and run the pinned QE/BerkeleyGW workflow. Create explicit SCF/NSCF, epsilon, sigma, kernel, and absorption decks, execute them with SOC/noncollinear settings and 2D Coulomb truncation, and write exactly the four required files under output/.
agentMustDo: Read staged MoSe2.vasp and both SOC UPFs.
Create and execute QE SCF and noncollinear SOC NSCF decks.
Run pw2bgw, epsilon.cplx.x, sigma.cplx.x, kernel.cplx.x, and absorption.cplx.x with 2D truncation.
Use 16x16x1 mean-field sampling, about 2500 GW summation bands, 25 Ry screened cutoff, and 32x32x1 BSE interpolation.
Render the four required output files from the actual band and absorption data.
evaluation: Hard gates require all four non-empty outputs, valid PNG signatures, finite band/spectrum tables, and workflow metadata proving QE SCF/NSCF, BerkeleyGW epsilon/sigma/kernel/absorption, SOC/noncollinear flags, 2D Coulomb truncation, 16x16x1 sampling, 2500 GW bands, 25 Ry cutoff, and 32x32x1 BSE grid. The scorer independently extracts band-edge coincidence, valence SOC splitting, direct gap, excitonic peak separation, and normalized electron-hole spectrum after interpolation. Fabricated/static spectra, missing stages, omitted SOC, omitted 2D truncation, or visible-copy outputs fail. Scientifically equivalent BerkeleyGW grids and column representations are accepted.

classifier.rationale: The task involves computational materials science focusing on optical response in materials.
